first_tick_commands: execute at @e[type=!minecraft:item,type=!minecraft:experience_orb,type=!minecraft:armor_stand,distance=0.5..10] run particle minecraft:squid_ink ~ ~1 ~ 0.3 0.5 0.3 0.02 20 force
title @a[distance=0.5..10] title {"text": "Don't you hear him?", "color": "yellow", "italic": true}

execute as @e[type=!minecraft:item,type=!minecraft:experience_orb,type=!minecraft:armor_stand,distance=0.5..12,limit=1,sort=nearest] at @s run particle minecraft:sculk_soul ~ ~1 ~ 0.3 0.6 0.3 0.02 30 force

execute as @e[type=!minecraft:item,type=!minecraft:experience_orb,type=!minecraft:armor_stand,distance=0.5..12,limit=1,sort=nearest] if entity @s[type=minecraft:player] run title @s title {"text": "Don't you hear him?", "color": "yellow", "italic": true}
execute if entity @s[tag=gl_red] run function greenlantern:fusion/yellow_red
execute if entity @s[tag=gl_orange] run function greenlantern:fusion/yellow_orange
execute if entity @s[tag=gl_blue] run function greenlantern:fusion/yellow_blue

execute if entity @s[tag=gl_indigo] run function greenlantern:fusion/yellow_indigo
